configuration.scope: OCBE + GL192 student only; no teacher/preprocessing/H2D/scoring in primary FPS
configuration.input: GPU-resident twelve synthetic teacher tensors [B,261,768][:,5:]; patch count256

conditions.original: No Q cache; original elementwise projection; diagnostics disabled as in old audit
conditions.cached_loop: Q GS cached; original elementwise projection; diagnostics disabled
conditions.fused: Q GS cached; exact fused projection; group-contiguous layout for DGT; diagnostics disabled
conditions.dense_control: Dense128 without Rank2, same GPU process and synthetic inputs

configuration.only_change: Inference execution for Q, optional disabling of training diagnostics; no architecture, learned weights, training, loss or AUC changes

metadata_source.note: Params, major GFLOPs, size and AUC are historical metadata; params and serialized size rechecked, FLOPs not reprofiled in timing process

configuration.profiling: After BOTH GPUs finish timing, separate processes; no profiler in timing workers
configuration.group_layout: [group,batch,patch,2*channel], contiguous input to each original per-group Linear; no gate/attention/mixing batching changes
configuration.arithmetic: Original FP32 (w0*x0+w1*x1)+w2*x2 with explicit mul_rn/add_rn, no FMA
configuration.acceptance: All seven scene outputs, student reconstructions and anomaly scores must be bitwise equal across original/cached/fused; failure recorded, not accepted as corrected timing
